fields.label: Enable route planning
fields.description: Master switch. Off hides Today's Route everywhere and the app shows Van Stock in that slot instead. Individual vans can override this.

fields.label: Require PIN unlock
fields.description: Master switch. On, drivers set a 4-digit PIN and re-enter it after 2 hours idle. Off, the app goes straight to Home after login. Individual vans and users can override this.

fields.options: Override order, most specific wins: Assigned User row → Vansale Configuration (van) → these global settings. Anything left on Follow Global falls through to here.
